groups.title: Big screen + phones
groups.note: Open the host link on the presenter screen; the audience scans the QR and plays from their phones. Bots fill empty seats.

games.title: Defend the Attention Tower
games.blurb: Gremlins march on the tower every 25 seconds. Answer the quiz right and drag a gun onto the board with your name on it; a streak makes it bigger, six in a row is God Mode. Hold as many waves as you can.

games.title: Survival Quiz
games.blurb: Everyone's knight stands in the arena. Answer the quiz right to keep your sword swinging; the wrong and the slow fall first. Last knight standing wins.

games.title: Brawl: Quiz Mode
games.blurb: Knights roam and meet in duels. Each encounter is a quiz: the first right answer strikes, wrong answers hurt, and if nobody answers the swords decide.

games.title: Survival Brawl
games.blurb: Tap-to-move battle royale. Steer your knight from your phone, dodge the fights you would lose, pick the ones you would win, and outlast the field.

games.title: Marshmallow Challenge
games.blurb: The classic team-building build: spaghetti, tape, string and one marshmallow. Teams build a tower together from their phones in a live physics world on the big screen, and it can really fall over. Tallest standing tower wins.

games.title: Marshmallow Challenge 2D
games.blurb: The same build, side on and quick to learn. The room tapes spaghetti into one tower from their phones in a physics world the server runs: carry a stick through the tower, let an end go where it touches, and hope the triangles hold when the clock stops.

games.title: Idea Map
games.blurb: A mind map on the big screen that the whole room grows. Phones tap a branch, type an idea and send it, and like the ideas they love. Solo, it is a mind-map editor.

games.title: Color & Sound
games.blurb: Paint on the shared canvas from your phone and hear it: an upright stroke sounds as a chord, a sideways one as a melody, and every mark keeps blooming after you lift your finger.

groups.title: Play on one screen
groups.note: Solo or watch-along games, no phones needed.

games.title: Tiny Kingdom Quiz
games.blurb: The original. Walk your hero through a pixel kingdom with the pad or WASD, strike what stands in the way, and answer quiz rounds along the road.

games.title: Tiny Towers
games.blurb: Classic 3D tower defence on Kenney's kit: build ballistas, cannons and turrets on the grass beside the road, upgrade them, and hold the crystal against orcs, raiders and UFOs.

games.title: Survival Island
games.blurb: A free-for-all of pixel knights on a small island with a live leaderboard by survival time. Pick the field size and watch it play out.

games.title: Tiny Kingdom Tournament
games.blurb: Knights fight it out in the castle arena, round after round, until one champion is left.

games.title: Archers vs Knights
games.blurb: Two armies meet on a pixel field: archers hold the line at range while knights charge it. Watch the lines break.

builders.title: aha-room SDK
builders.blurb: Scan-to-play rooms in three lines: host, join, replicated state.

builders.title: Asset library
builders.blurb: Free game art, sound and 3D models on the CDN, with a catalog and starter maps.
